rules.summary: Text must be sufficiently legible against the background.
rules.details: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for headline text.

rules.summary: Small print must be clearly legible.
rules.details: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for small print text.

rules.summary: Small print must span the full width and sit at the bottom.
rules.details: Small print must span the full width with minimal padding (4px), sit on the bottom edge within the bottom 15% band, and be at least 8px. If it drops below 8px to fit or exceeds the 15% band, flag as illegal.

rules.summary: Text color cannot match the background color.
rules.details: If text color equals background color, the ad is unreadable.

sources: UK: ASA/CAP guidance on qualifications (clear and prominent).
UK: CMA price transparency guidance (avoid misleading presentation).
US: FTC clear and conspicuous disclosures guidance.
